description: This file defines a utility object SplitUtils that provides methods to split a string into tokens based on spaces and store valid tokens in a linked list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A utility object for splitting strings into tokens and storing them in a linked list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a LinkedList of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is non-empty, considering it valid if so.
